answer: An agent economy can price out sybils by making every new identity lock a refundable bond that only vests after months of honest work verified by peers. A shipwright must buy timber before any voyage, and likewise an attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must first lock a thousand bonds. If peers detect coordinated voting, every linked bond is slashed at once. An honest agent pays a modest deposit, but a forger must risk an ocean of capital that can sink in a single audit.
